# Google Cloud Client Libraries for Swift - Cloud Key Management Service (KMS) API

[![Platform Compatibility](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fswiftpackageindex.com%2Fapi%2Fpackages%2Fgoogleapis%2Fswift-google-cloud-kms-v1%2Fbadge%3Ftype%3Dplatforms)](https://swiftpackageindex.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-kms-v1)

Manages keys and performs cryptographic operations in a central cloud
service, for direct use by other cloud resources and applications.

## Overview

The following types provide methods to make RPCs. They are a good starting point
to learn about this library.

- `AutokeyClient`: Provides interfaces for using Cloud KMS Autokey to provision new CryptoKeys, ready for Customer Managed Encryption Key (CMEK) use, on-demand.
- `AutokeyAdminClient`: Provides interfaces for managing Cloud KMS Autokey folder-level or project-level configurations.
- `EkmServiceClient`: Manages external cryptographic keys and operations using those keys.
- `HsmManagementClient`: Provides interfaces for managing HSM instances.
- `KeyManagementServiceClient`: Manages cryptographic keys and operations using those keys.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `AutokeyClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudKMSV1
import GoogleCloudLocation
import GoogleIAMV1
import GoogleLongRunning

func sample(parent: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudKMSV1.AutokeyClient()
  let items = client.listKeyHandlesByItems(
    request: ListKeyHandlesRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "\(parent)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-kms-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-kms-v1.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudKMSV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudKMSV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-kms-v1
```
